title: Minecraft in Monster Hunter: World
tagline: Hunt Monster Hunter: World's monsters as a Minecraft player: swords, bows and blocks against real monsters.
description: Step into Monster Hunter: World as a Minecraft player. Minecraft's view, movement and hotbar are laid over the real game, so you fight Monster Hunter: World's monsters with Minecraft's swords and bows and your hits take real health off them. Load into the Training Area, an expedition or a solo quest, and Minecraft joins on its own. F6 to F10 switch the link's parts on and off. Both games run at the same time: Monster Hunter: World draws the world and Minecraft draws your hands and blocks on top.

version.note: Made for the final PC update (15.23.00) in DirectX 11. Solo only.
A Microsoft account that owns Minecraft: Java Edition. The app sets up Minecraft 1.21.1 itself.

knownIssues: Solo only: it changes monster health, so never join online sessions or answer SOS flares while you play it.
The link files are only in Monster Hunter: World's folder while you play it from the app. We take them out as soon as the game closes, so starting it from Steam to play online is just as before.
Only the final PC update works, in DirectX 11. The app switches DirectX 12 off for you, and Remove puts your old setting back.
If another mod already has a dinput8.dll in Monster Hunter: World's folder (Stracker's Loader or ReShade do), Play asks you to move it out first. We never replace or delete your files.
Minecraft joins once you're in an area (the Training Area, an expedition or a quest), not in menus or Astera's loading screens.

important.text: Before your first Play, open Monster Hunter: World's Options > Display and set Screen Mode to Borderless Window. Minecraft can only sit on top of a window, not full screen. The game remembers it.
